what_requires_paid_calls: whether an agent actually changes its next action when given the computed dependency target; this is a behavioural property and cannot be derived from deterministic code

why_it_cannot_be_assumed.read_scope_fact: identical wire bytes produced 100 percent first-try compliance on one model and 11 percent or below on another
sixteen models inspected the critical provenance path in about one episode in five and produced stale-consistent decisions in about three quarters of episodes

cost_driver: measured token accounting shows a fixed context floor of 46,763 tokens and a 12.03x cost ratio for identical work, so cost is dominated by context length rather than by the reasoning itself
